//: NOT NAMED tsconfig.json, ON PURPOSE. Vercel reads api/tsconfig.json when it
compiles the serverless function, so a file named that changes how the
PRODUCTION API is built. The first version of it set module: ESNext, Vercel
duly emitted import statements into a package with no type: module, and
every API route died with 'Cannot use import statement outside a module'.
A type check config has no business deciding the shape of a deployed
artifact, so it gets a name Vercel ignores and CI passes explicitly:
Vercel goes back to its own defaults, which worked.
